evidence.observation: 3.3 ppm at the start of growth, in line with the ramp baseline of about 2-6 ppm
Rose every reading to 33.2 ppm over 12 min of growth, about 10x the baseline
Holds at 100 sccm setpoint, so the Ar mass flow controller is not stuck
Steady at about 760 Torr, with no pressure rise that would suggest an exhaust blockage
T holds at 750 °C with steady heater power at about 46%, so no sign of thermocouple drift

args.missing_evidence: No normal-run reference values (ref) were provided for O2 during growth. A leak check (for example isolate the tube and watch pressure hold, or raise Ar flow and see whether O2 dilutes) would confirm air ingress at a seal. Characterization of the sample is still to come.
